name: Volga
slug: A recent stop whose frozen gatehouse is too faint a memory for Gerk’s doorway.
description: Volga is a place the party had just visited, remembered for a tall frozen gatehouse they climbed. It was cold and a little spooky, and the visit is tied to a spear-in-the-head moment.

log.summary: Sylan uses Volga as a memory drill for Gerk’s doorway, walking him through the frozen gatehouse: tall, cold, a little spooky, and the spear-in-the-head moment. Gerk only partly remembers it and would not call the memory strong, so they switch the target to Twin Peaks.
